title: Organize specs by conceptual layers and kebab-case slugs instead of numeric prefixes
summary: Use conceptual layer directories (docs/specs/<layer>/*.md) and stable [kebab-slug] identifiers instead of 01- prefixes or P1.1/AC-1 numbering.
resolution: Allows packs and criteria to be split, merged, or re-layered without renumbering every identifier or breaking historical run records.

comments.body: Avoid numeric prefixes and organize packs around conceptual code layers with refactoring support across packs.

title: Protect external standards behind person-ratified overrides and keep one append-only decisions.jsonl log
summary: Store adopted external standards in docs/standards/*.md read-only during local refactors, require person-authored decisions in docs/decisions.jsonl for overrides, and fold load-bearing implementation notes directly into owning packs.
resolution: Prevents local edits from silently drifting away from shared standards (e.g., standards.thefocus.ai) while eliminating duplicate decisions.md and learnings.md prose files.

comments.body: Separate external standards from refactorable local specs, require explicit overrides, and consolidate decisions into JSONL while keeping specs minimal.

title: Bundle zero-dependency check-specs.ts inside each skill and record immutable timestamped runs under docs/runs/
summary: Ship identical zero-dependency Node 24 copies of check-specs.ts inside all three skill directories (with --init bootstrapping) and store every verification pass under docs/runs/<timestamp>_<sha>/.
resolution: Ensures installing any individual skill via `skills add --skill <name>` or copying `.agents/` + `docs/` into an empty workspace works standalone with zero npm dependencies.

comments.body: Build a standalone session-spec-verify skill repo in The-Focus-AI based on the modular cold-rebuild prototype.

title: Open on the Swiss index functional overview
summary: Use the Reading room navigation structure with a Swiss index visual treatment. Group modules by function and let the reader drill down to rules and evidence.
resolution: The reader first needs to see the whole collection and its recorded verification before inspecting an individual module.

comments.body: I want to see the functional areas at a high level and zoom in when needed.
I chose Swiss index for the visual direction.

title: Scope browsing and analysis to the docs collection
summary: Use local spec packs as the inventory. Treat standards, decisions, and verification runs as supporting records.
resolution: The overview should report what the loaded docs and evidence can establish about each module.

comments.body: I want to see how much is verified and where the gaps are. Keep the scope to what is in the docs.

title: Compare a behavior ask against the documented contract
summary: Start with the behavior the reader wants. Show existing specification, gaps, proposed contract changes, and verification to add.
resolution: The reader wants to know whether the behavior is already specified and which parts of the contract would need to change.

comments.body: I want to ask about a behavior and see whether it is already specified and what it would take to make it happen.

title: Serve the single HTML viewer over localhost with one command
summary: Keep the frontend in one HTML file and use a small HTTP server for live docs and Ollama routes.
resolution: Both docs loading and model requests need an HTTP path. A shared origin avoids separate browser cross-origin configuration.

comments.body: I want one command to serve the viewer so it can fetch the docs and reach Ollama over HTTP.
I used a loopback Node server to serve the frontend and relay Ollama requests over the same origin.

title: Decide whether reviewed proposals should enter the docs workflow
summary: Open questions are whether reviewed imports should be saved to docs and whether behavior comparisons should draft exact Markdown edits.
resolution: The current viewer keeps imports and comparisons in the browser session. Any persistence or edit workflow still needs a decision.

comments.body: I asked whether an import should stay temporary and whether suggestions should include an exact Markdown proposal.

title: Keep a persistent right-side freeform chat with full-docs Ollama prompt caching, Markdown rendering, and a dedicated spec-viewer skill
summary: Replace the separate Ask about behavior screen with an always-present right-side chat column that includes all loaded docs/ files in a deterministic leading system prompt for Ollama KV cache reuse, renders Markdown responses, and ships inside a standalone spec-viewer skill.
resolution: Lets users ask freeform or module-scoped questions from any view while reusing Ollama's prompt cache across turns and launching the viewer directly from an installed skill in any repository.

comments.body: I think there should be a freeform chat that always exists, where you can ask about anything. We should include all of the specs inside of the message, so that we can reuse the ollama caching. Also we need to render markdown in the response. Remember that we want this to be something that's installed as a skill, so that you can inspect the local setup if needed.

title: Unify 4 overlapping v1 skills into 2 core skills plus 1 read-only lens organized by Mutation Tiers and 5 rule kinds
summary: Consolidate spec-extract and spec-refactor into spec-distill, merge Cold-Rebuild Sufficiency Audit into spec-verify, rename spec-viewer to thin spec-view, introduce explicit Tier 0/1/2 tags, 5 rule kinds, OGIS distinguishing-input grilling, CLS candidate staging, and 4-status decisions.jsonl.
resolution: Eliminates artificial handoffs between extraction and restructuring while grounding every rule in formal Mutation Tiers, W-drift localization, Anti-Specs, and Golden Pins.
rejected: Keep separate spec-extract and spec-refactor skills with overlapping docs/ mutation rules
Allow unratified single-session inferences to overwrite active Tier 1 or Tier 0 packs directly

pins.input: docs/decisions.jsonl record with status:'decided', rejected[], pins[]
pins.expected: Validates cleanly alongside append-only D-1..D-9 v1 entries

pins.input: Verdict with kind:'assumption' and verdict:'fail', diagnosis:'w_drift'
pins.expected: Localizes repair to Tier 2 World Assumption without modifying Tier 0/1

comments.body: Simplify and unify the skills around the specification extraction science into a v2 prototype.
